if: the document is a bill of supply referred to in clause (c) of sub-section (3) of section 31
it is issued under rule 49 of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the bill of supply MUST carry the supplier's name, address and GSTIN
note: One mandatory particular of rule 49(a), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: name, address and Goods and Services Tax Identification Number of the supplier;
